These cases are checked with the standard DP. Let `dpA[i]` and `dpB[i]` be the best total ending with drink A or B at hour i. Then `dpA[i] = max(dpA[i-1], dpB[i-2]) + a[i]` and `dpB[i] = max(dpB[i-1], dpA[i-2]) + b[i]`, with out-of-range terms treated as 0. The skipped hour is the cleanse. Both provided examples match this recurrence.
